name: Rhythmic Hail
body:
Rhythmic Hail

School conjuration (creation) [sonic, water]; Level bard 3, druid 3, hunter 3, oracle 3, shaman 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area cylinder (60-ft. radius, 40 ft. high)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You call down a shower of hail that drums in eerie rhythms wherever it strikes. Like mundane hail, it extinguishes unprotected flames, and imposes a -4 penalty on ranged attacks and sound-based Perception checks. Within the radius of the hail, all creatures that can hear it gain a +2 bonus on Perform checks, and suffer a -1 penalty on saving throws against bardic performances and raging song, as well as spells and effects that fascinate creatures, deafen or deal sonic damage.

If you have the ability to use bardic performance or raging song, you treat your level in the appropriate class as 1 higher when determining the effects of these abilities. This doesn’t grant access to types of performance you wouldn’t otherwise have, only enhances the effects of performances you can already use.

When your caster level reaches 12th, the bonus on Perform checks increases to +4 and the penalty on saving throws increases to -2.

Effects and abilities that modify the impact of weather apply as normal.
